description: In the beginning: creation, covenant, and the patriarchs.
Moses defies Pharaoh and leads Israel out of bondage.
Laws of holiness and discipline for a set-apart people.
Forty years of wilderness wandering and endurance.
Moses renews the covenant before the promised land.
The conquest of Canaan, one battle at a time.
Deliverers rise again and again for a wayward people.
A foreigner's loyalty and quiet devotion are rewarded.
David's rise, from shepherd boy to giant-slayer.
David's reign and its triumphs and failures.
Solomon's wisdom and the kingdom's slow division.
Prophets and kings navigate the fall of two kingdoms.
Israel's lineage retold to renew a scattered people's hope.
The temple, its kings, and a nation's faithfulness.
Exiles return and patiently rebuild the temple.
A cupbearer rebuilds Jerusalem's walls against opposition.
A queen risks everything to save her people.
A righteous man's suffering and unwavering endurance.
Songs of worship, lament, and trust in God.
Wisdom sayings for a discerning and guarded heart.
A weary search for meaning under the sun.
A love song celebrating devotion between two hearts.
Prophecies of judgment and a coming deliverer.
The weeping prophet perseveres through a nation's collapse.
Grief poured out in compassion for a fallen city.
Visions of wheels, valleys of bones, and divine glory.
Faith tested in a lion's den and a fiery furnace.
God's relentless and faithful love for an unfaithful people.
A locust plague heralds the coming day of the Lord.
A shepherd boldly demands justice for the poor.
A short and sharp word of judgment against pride.
A reluctant prophet learns patience with mercy.
A call to act justly and love mercy.
Judgment falls on a cruel and violent empire.
Wrestling honestly with God until faith holds firm.
A warning of coming judgment and a promised remnant.
A call to patiently finish rebuilding what was abandoned.
Visions of a rebuilt Jerusalem and a coming king.
A final call back to covenant faithfulness.
The promised Messiah, King of the Jews.
A fast-moving account of a bold, active ministry.
A compassionate gospel for the outcast and overlooked.
The Word made flesh, full of grace and truth.
The apostles boldly carry the gospel across the world.
Justification by faith, laid out with careful reasoning.
Love is patient, love is kind - the heart of the church.
Comfort and endurance through weakness and hardship.
Freedom in faith over the burden of the law.
The whole armor of God, worn for spiritual defense.
Contentment and joy learned in every circumstance.
Christ preeminent over all things, held fast by faith.
Steadfast hope while waiting for the Lord's return.
Standing firm and unshaken while waiting it out.
Guarding sound doctrine within a young church.
Fight the good fight to the very end.
Sound teaching to guard a church's good order.
A personal appeal for forgiveness and brotherly love.
A great cloud of witnesses testifies to living faith.
Patience and perseverance through trials of every kind.
Enduring suffering with hope and quiet perseverance.
A warning to guard against false teachers.
God is love, and love casts out fear.
Walking in truth and love within the community.
Commending hospitality shown out of love.
A call to contend earnestly for the faith.
A final vision of cosmic battle and ultimate victory.
